structured_review.summary: R3 correctness review of WP-SCP-022 020H part 3 at commit 270823b. All fix-round-1 through fix-round-4 closures verified present in ADOPT-001 §12.7 / STATUS.md / DISPATCH-NOTE / DECISIONS.md. The two fix-round-4 MIN closures (§12.7.5 two-case PATCH expansion and §12.7.4 Gate 1 SCP-CODEOWNERS reword) are syntactically correct and semantically sound. Single-quoted EOF heredoc in §12.7.5 prevents variable expansion correctly; rendered terminator is at column 0 after Markdown list-item indent strip; both JSON payloads are valid. Gate 1 security guarantee preserved post-reword: multi-maintainer CODEOWNER approval + dismiss_stale_reviews intact; single-operator documentation-only path unchanged. All §12.7.N section cross-references resolve. 020H.2 disambiguation is consistent across §12.7.13, DISPATCH-NOTE, and STATUS.md. DISPATCH-NOTE / STATUS.md cross-references survive cumulative edits. One new MIN finding: SCP-E007 is emitted by policy-check.yml line 528 (Validate rule-config against schema step) but is absent from §12.7.7 error-code table — the DISPATCH-NOTE acceptance row (vi) claim that codes are verified-emitted by the workflow is incomplete. One nit: §12.7.13 parenthetical references VERSIONING.md as if it is a current document when it ships in 020H.1. Zero CRIT or MAJ findings. Fixpoint criterion met.
